phase_name: Deploy, Full Gate, and Regression Sweep

objectives.description: Deploy source store to .claude/ via deploy-headless.sh (non-destructive default mode), fixing a missing manifest.json scripts registration for the new harness
Verify byte-identical source/deploy parity for all touched files
Run full suite set (literature-convert.sh --self-test, test-quality-gate-notation.sh, test-literature-convert.sh) and confirm identical source vs. deployed output
Update plan checklists (per-phase Tasks and the top-level Testing & Validation section) with final evidence

deviations.description: Deploy the source store to .claude/ via the project's deploy path
deviations.reason: A first deploy pass revealed tests/test-quality-gate-notation.sh (created in Phase 1) was never added to manifest.json's provides.scripts list, so it silently failed to deploy despite the deploy command succeeding. Fixed by adding the missing manifest entry and redeploying; this is a one-line addition, not a scope expansion.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: non-destructive `deploy-headless.sh` default mode, run twice — a first pass revealed `tests/test-quality-gate-notation.sh` was missing from `manifest.json`'s `provides.scripts` list (Phase 1's new harness was never registered), fixed, then redeployed)*

notes: Deploy used deploy-headless.sh default (non-destructive resync) mode, never --wipe -- deliberate given concurrent agents were actively working in the same repo throughout this dispatch (other in-flight, uncommitted changes were visible under agent-system/extensions/core/** and specs/{009,079,080,084}/** the whole time; none were touched by this task). Byte-identical source/deploy parity confirmed for literature_quality_gate.py, literature-convert.sh, tests/test-quality-gate-notation.sh, and the new domain context note (after the manifest fix). Suite results: literature-convert.sh --self-test 26/26 fixtures pass (source and deployed output byte-identical via diff); tests/test-quality-gate-notation.sh 5/5 fixtures pass (source and deployed output byte-identical); tests/test-literature-convert.sh 13 passed, 0 failed. Every phase commit in this task (1 through 6) deliberately excluded specs/TODO.md, specs/state.json, and specs/events.jsonl from its staged paths -- those shared files were being concurrently modified by other in-flight agents for unrelated tasks (9, 79) throughout this dispatch, and this task's own .return-meta.json / task-level status transition is the orchestrator's responsibility at postflight, not this agent's.
